neighbours.label: A list: later pieces of some religious names ('ana' in Vajrayana, 'u' in Ketu, 'es' in Spes, 'i' in Dei, 'ium' in Gentium) and ' marriage' in church talk; other religious words in the same frames stay low.
fire: The Vajrayana path uses many rituals.
Tantric Vajrayana masters teach in Nepal.
Its charts place Ketu in the ninth house.
The priest quoted Gaudium et Spes on Sunday.
He joined Opus Dei as a young man.
She read Lumen Gentium in the seminar.
Our Archdiocese offers marriage preparation classes.
Astrologers say Ketu rules past lives.
quiet: The Mahayana path uses many rituals.

Its charts place Mars in the ninth house.

notes: Probes: 'ana' 0.99, ' marriage' 0.73, 'u' 0.37-0.58, 'es' 0.49, 'i' 0.35, 'ium' 0.27, but ' apost' 0.10, ' priest' 0.09, and Mahayana 0.03, even though it also ends in 'ana', and Theravada 0.02. So this is not about split pieces or religion in general. Near misses stay religious, including one Mahayana.
